title: new fortress energys finance chief guinta resigns 2026 08 21
text:
Aug 21 (Reuters) - New Fortress Energy (NFE.O)
, opens new tab
 ‌said on Friday its Chief Financial Officer, ​Christopher Guinta, ​would step down, effective ⁠August 21, 2026.
Shares ​of the company ​were up about 1.4% in extended trading.
The company ​said it intends ​to begin a search ‌process, ⁠including both internal and external candidates, to identify a ​new CFO.
Guinta ​has ⁠served as the liquefied ​natural gas developer's ​finance ⁠chief since August 2018, according to ⁠its ​website.
